data.display_address: Burj Views A, Burj Views, Downtown Dubai, Dubai
data.long_description:
A rare opportunity to own one of the most spacious one-bedroom apartments in Burj Views A, Downtown Dubai. With the largest layout in the building at approximately 910 sq ft, this residence combines generous living areas, smart functionality, and an unbeatable location — a combination that is extremely hard to find for a one-bedroom in Downtown.

Interior & Features

-Fully furnished with tasteful, subtle upgrades.
-Bright interiors with large windows allowing plenty of natural light.
-Two bathrooms for added comfort and convenience.
-Dedicated utility space with washing machine setup.
-Excellent storage capacity, making the home practical as well as stylish.

Building & Amenities

Burj Views is a prestigious development by Emaar, consisting of three towers set on a shared podium. Residents benefit from a wide range of lifestyle amenities, including:

-Multiple swimming pools with landscaped sun decks.
-Fully equipped gyms and fitness facilities.
-Indoor sports courts, children’s play areas, and recreation spaces.
-Secure parking across three basement levels, 24-hour security, and high-speed elevators.

Location & Access

Prime Downtown Dubai address, just minutes from Burj Khalifa, Dubai Mall, and Dubai Fountain.
Excellent road connectivity via Sheikh Zayed Road and nearby public transport.
Beautiful views of the Downtown skyline, parks, and surrounding landmarks.

This home is more than just a large one-bedroom — with two bathrooms, dedicated laundry space, and exceptional storage, it offers comfort and practicality in one of Dubai’s most iconic addresses. A rare find in both size and location.
